events.body: RydeTAXI is metered, so extra distance enters the fare and unexcused off-route segments are refundable in km at this trip's rate: $39.42 ÷ 27.96 km = $1.4099/km [F5][F8][RD-2]. The trace settles two off-route segments and the absence of any qualifying traffic incident or band-1/2 congestion on the replaced stretches [F3][F4][F11][F12][F13][RD-4]. The chat record is complete and contains no rider message at all, so nothing was agreed to before either segment [F9][RD-5]. The driver's post-trip statement that "the GPS rerouted me" is a claim made after the trip and not consent, and under G11 a driver's assertion cannot establish rider agreement [F10][RD-5]. No rider stop was measured in either segment, so RD-3 cannot exempt them [F3][F4][RD-3]. Both segments therefore count: 2.46 km + 3.37 km = 5.83 km × $1.4099/km = $8.2197 → $8.22 [F3][F4][F5][RD-2]. No account flag: the driver has 0 upheld route disputes in the last 90 days, so RD-6 is not triggered [F16][RD-6]. Safety screen: I read the complaint and the driver's statement; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F9][F10][F1][F2][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: You're getting $8.22 back as a Ryde voucher. We looked at your trip and found two stretches where the driver went off route without a good reason. Those added 5.83 km, which comes to $8.22 at your trip's rate. The rest of the extra distance on the bill couldn't be linked to any specific stretch, and the small waiting charge stands, so neither is refunded. The voucher goes onto your Ryde account. Nothing changes on your account — you're all set. Thanks for flagging this.

DRIVER: This trip was reviewed and $8.22 is being issued to the rider as a Ryde voucher. Two stretches of the route were treated as off-route: the rider didn't agree to them in the chat, and saying the GPS rerouted you afterwards isn't agreement. Those two stretches added 5.83 km. The remaining billed extra distance wasn't tied to any measured stretch, so it isn't refunded, and the waiting charge stays as metered. No flag goes on your account — this doesn't count against you, and your record here stays clean.
